fix.note: Used to address a group; already polite, so no -님.

ex.en: Everyone, please be quiet for a moment.

ex.s: 오늘 와 주신 여러분, 정말 감사합니다.
ex.en: Thank you all so much for coming today.
My father runs a small business.
I started a business with a friend.

fix.note: 준비하다 = to prepare. 준비됐어요? = Are you ready?

ex.en: I'll take care of making dinner.
Are your trip preparations going well?
I couldn't sleep properly last night.
Did you understand this explanation properly?

notes: Ungrammatical 여러분 모두 감사합니다; spacing 잘되다/잘하다 as one word; mistranslation of 제대로.
